|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Leia's Lightsaber]] (version 1 of 1). The image here is the Players Committee repository image of this original state. This is the current text. A same-words slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image it reprints are one version on one article (Bill, 17 November 2026).
